Shaco|jgl.identity: Hybrid damage assassin (physical or magic depending on the build), a master of deception. Deceive (Q) teleports him and makes him invisible, Jack in the Box (W) places an invisible box that fears, then attacks, Two-Shiv Poison (E) slows and deals more damage to wounded targets, and Hallucinate (R) creates a clone that explodes when it dies. His attacks from behind deal more damage (passive).
Shaco|jgl.playstyle: Jungler built for very early ganks, invades and controlled trolling. Shaco creates chaos: invisible ganks, boxes placed in the enemy jungle, stolen camps. There are two builds: boxes (W maxed) or physical damage (E maxed).
Shaco|jgl.early_game: Place boxes at your first camp for a faster clear, then gank very early with Q (invisibility): Shaco is one of the earliest-ganking junglers. Invade the enemy jungle with boxes placed on their camps in advance.
Shaco|jgl.level_1: Jack in the Box (W) first. Place several boxes on the first camp to clear it fast.
Shaco|jgl.level_2: Deceive (Q). Invisibility and teleport: a gank is possible from level 2 on a pushed lane.
Shaco|jgl.level_3: Two-Shiv Poison (E). Passive slow and damage: Q → attacks from behind → E, with a box placed nearby to fear.
Shaco|jgl.level_6: Hallucinate: a clone that fools the enemy and explodes when it dies. Use it to dodge an ability, fake an escape or add damage.
power_spikes: First completed item: burst that kills a carry.
Shaco|jgl.jungle_plan: Use boxes to clear, then very early ganks and invades. Place boxes on enemy camps and in bushes near objectives: they also give vision. Steal camps and harass the enemy jungler. Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons are easier to steal with boxes already in place.
Shaco|jgl.trading: Ganking: Q behind the target → attacks from behind → E → W to fear. Skirmishing: use the clone to fool the enemy. Give up on it against sweepers and targets surrounded by allies.
mistakes: Using Q to engage with no way out.
Placing boxes anywhere instead of on walking paths.
Staying in grouped fights where you're fragile.

matchup_notes.Viego: Burst him before he possesses your allies.
matchup_notes.Graves: He beats you in duels: trap his camps and gank elsewhere.
matchup_notes.Talon: He's just as mobile and bursts harder: avoid duels.
matchup_notes.Nocturne: His ultimate finds you even while invisible: keep Q to escape.

Shaco|jgl.mid_game: Picks, invades and objectives. Place boxes around objectives before fights.
Shaco|jgl.late_game: Picks on isolated carries and disrupting the enemy team with your clone and boxes.
Shaco|jgl.ahead: Choke out the enemy jungler and hunt the carries.
Shaco|jgl.behind: Look for picks on isolated targets and place boxes for vision.
Shaco|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to create chaos early through ganks and invades, then hunt isolated carries.
Shaco|jgl.final_tip: Place your boxes in advance where the enemy will walk: they fear and give vision.
